tools.name: fs_read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file to read.

encoding.description: Character encoding used to decode the file.

offset.description: Zero-based line number to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

tools.name: fs_write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Handles text content with proper encoding.

path.description: Destination path of the file to write.

content.description: Full textual content to write into the file.

encoding.description: Character encoding used to encode the file.

mode.description: POSIX file mode expressed in octal, for example 0644.

tools.name: fs_edit_file
tools.description: Make selective edits to a text file using exact string replacement. Each edit replaces one occurrence of oldText with newText. Returns a git-style diff of the applied changes.

path.description: Path of the file to edit.

edits.description: Ordered list of replacements to apply.

oldText.description: Exact text to search for, including indentation.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of the first.

dryRun.description: Return the diff without writing the file.

tools.name: fs_list_directory
tools.description: List the contents of a directory, optionally recursing into subdirectories. Entries are annotated with their type, size and modification time.

tools.name: fs_search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files whose contents match a regular expression. Returns matching paths with line numbers and the matched line, sorted by relevance.

query.description: Regular expression to match against file contents.

glob.description: Restrict the search to files matching this glob.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

contextLines.description: Number of surrounding lines to include.

tools.name: fs_move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Fails if the destination already exists unless overwrite is enabled.

source.description: Path of the file or directory to move.

overwrite.description: Replace the destination if it exists.

tools.name: fs_delete_path
tools.description: Delete a file or directory. Directories are only removed when recursive is set. This operation cannot be undone.

force.description: Ignore missing paths instead of failing.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show the working tree status of a git repository, including staged, unstaged and untracked files along with the current branch and upstream tracking information.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show changes between commits, the working tree and the index. Supports limiting the diff to specific paths and controlling the amount of context.

revision.description: Revision or revision range such as HEAD~3..HEAD.

paths.description: Restrict the diff to these paths.

unified.description: Lines of context around each hunk.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Record staged changes to the repository with a commit message. Optionally stage every tracked modification first and sign the resulting commit.

all.description: Stage every tracked modification before committing.

author.description: Override the author in the form Name <email>.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show the commit history of a repository with author, date and subject for each commit. Supports filtering by path, author and date range.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

since.description: Only commits after this date, in ISO 8601.

until.description: Only commits before this date, in ISO 8601.

tools.name: git_branch_create
tools.description: Create a new branch from a starting point and optionally check it out immediately.

startPoint.description: Commit, branch or tag to branch from.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request on GitHub from a head branch into a base branch, with a title, body, reviewers and labels.

base.description: Branch the changes should be merged into.

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

reviewers.description: GitHub usernames to request a review from.

tools.name: github_list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a GitHub repository, filtered by state, labels, assignee and milestone, ordered by creation or update time.

labels.description: Only issues carrying all of these labels.

tools.name: github_create_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing GitHub issue or pull request thread.

tools.name: github_merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge an open pull request using the merge, squash or rebase strategy, optionally deleting the head branch afterwards.

deleteBranch.description: Delete the head branch after merging.

tools.name: postgres_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the configured PostgreSQL database and return the rows as structured JSON. Statements that modify data are rejected.

params.description: Positional bind parameters for the statement.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: postgres_list_tables
tools.description: List the tables visible in the configured PostgreSQL database, including their schema, estimated row count and total size on disk.

schema.description: Restrict the listing to a single schema.

tools.name: postgres_describe_table
tools.description: Describe the columns, indexes, constraints and foreign keys of a PostgreSQL table.

includeConstraints.description: Include check and foreign key constraints.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread. Supports Block Kit payloads, thread replies and link unfurling controls.

channel.description: Channel ID or name such as C0123ABCD or #general.

blocks.description: Block Kit blocks describing the rich message layout.

threadTs.description: Timestamp of the parent message when replying in a thread.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List the Slack channels the bot can see, filtered by type and archival state, with pagination support.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search the Slack workspace history for messages matching a query, with optional channel and author filters.

query.description: Search query using Slack search syntax.

channel.description: Restrict the search to a channel.

from.description: Restrict the search to messages from this user.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the managed headless browser to a URL and wait until the requested load state is reached.

referer.description: Referer header to send with the navigation.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page or of a single element, returned as a base64 encoded PNG or JPEG image.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to capture. Omit for the whole page.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element identified by a CSS selector, scrolling it into view first and waiting for it to become actionable.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the element.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Perform an arbitrary HTTP request with full control over method, headers, body and redirect handling, returning status, headers and body.

headers.description: Request headers as a flat string map.

tools.name: vector_search
tools.description: Search an embedded document collection for the passages most similar to a query, returning ranked chunks with their similarity scores and metadata.

collection.description: Name of the collection to search.

minScore.description: Discard results below this similarity score.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with a title, time range, attendees, location and reminder settings, returning the created event identifier.

calendarId.description: Calendar to create the event in.

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the event to fire a reminder.
